summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Alki Consolidated Income ETF (IINC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks monthly distribution by actively managing a portfolio of large- and mid-cap US equity securities, combined with option strategies. IINC was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Alki.

holdings.infoBox: IINC is an equity ETF with a total of 117 individual holdings. The top holdings are First American Government Obligs X stock at 34.30%, OTHER ASSETS AND LIABILITIES at 10.47%, Cash Offset at 3.42%, The Gap at 1.65%, and Watsco at 1.58%.
